faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: The most common questions about using and troubleshooting your Pulsemetrics dashboard.

items.question: Why is my dashboard showing stale data?
items.answer: Check the connection status on your Integrations page. A source marked as syncing can take a few minutes to catch up; anything marked as disconnected needs to be reauthorized.

items.question: How do I invite a teammate?
items.answer: Go to the Team page and use the invite form to send an email invitation with a role attached. They will get access as soon as they accept.

items.question: Can I change my subscription plan?
items.answer: Yes. Visit the Billing page and select Change plan to move between tiers. Changes are prorated automatically for the current cycle.

items.question: How far back does my data history go?
items.answer: History depends on your plan: Starter keeps 7 days, Growth and Pro keep 90 days, and Enterprise plans can retain data indefinitely.

items.question: Is there an audit trail of account changes?
items.answer: Yes, every account, billing, data, and security change is recorded on the Audit Log page with a timestamp and the responsible user.

items.question: What happens if a data source fails to connect?
items.answer: You'll see an alert on the Integrations page and receive an email notification. Most connection issues resolve by reauthorizing the integration.

tips.title: Tips for a smooth setup
items: Start with one or two data sources, you can always connect more later.
Assign the Viewer role to anyone who only needs to check numbers, not edit dashboards.
Set up at least one alert before you go live so your team is notified the moment something changes.
